description: Solve the annual yield to maturity that prices the bond at the given market price.

frequency.description: Coupon payments per year, e.g. 2 for semiannual.

price.description: Market price of the bond, in the same units as face.

name: bond_ytm

outputSchema.description: Yield to maturity solved from a bond's market price.

yield_to_maturity.description: Annual yield to maturity, as a decimal.
